name: Belly Button Cotton Candy
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
When you consume belly button cotton candy, your weight and density are reduced for 10 minutes. While not completely weightless, you can be lifted easily and carried about one-handed by an average small child; if thrown, you simply float gently to the ground without taking any damage. You also gain resistance 5 to physical damage and weakness 15 to fire and water, and you take a –15-foot circumstance penalty to your Speeds (to a minimum Speed of 5 feet).

Effect: Belly Button Cotton Candy
